rv.q: Dinosaur World Live delivers an immersive family experience which celebrates imagination, learning and world class puppetry.
Built around those astonishing puppets, Dinosaur World Live is a fabulous show for children, especially three to nine-year-olds.
It’s a fun show for all young dinosaur enthusiasts, and the skill with which the creatures are portrayed makes it an entertaining experience for the adults who take them there.

cn.t: Critics agree this interactive puppet show delights its target audience of young children with impressive dinosaur creations, though it's more educational demonstration than traditional theatrical narrative.
